info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Channel Specific By Param1-spec
info.description: The Channel Management API facilitates the dynamic updating of specific channel configurations within the ATM network management system. This endpoint allows authorized users to modify attributes related to ATM networks based on a unique identifier (param1). Typical consumers of this API include banking institutions and financial services providers aiming to optimize their ATM operations. By utilizing this API, businesses can ensure their ATM networks are aligned with operational requirements and regulatory standards.

patch.description: This operation allows developers to modify the configuration or settings of a specific ATM Network Management resource identified by its unique ID. Ensure to provide all necessary attributes in the request body to successfully update the resource.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update details related to the ATM network management for a specific channel. It contains necessary information for the operation to be performed on the resource identified by RES-100045.

200.description: Request completed successfully and resource has been updated.
